grid, card builds and how each layout adapts. Heights are measured from the live build.
Two headings scale fluidly between breakpoints; everything else holds a fixed size, so
hierarchy comes from weight, colour and the mono voice rather than many sizes.
HEADLINE PATTERN · WHITE PHRASE + MUTED PHRASE

First phrase in #F5F7FA states the product; the muted #7F8B9D
phrase lands the benefit. Each ends with a full stop.
Every headline rises in word by word (0.07s stagger); screen readers
get the full sentence once via aria-label.
